programs.title: War of the Survival Worlds
programs.desc: Competitors from across the globe battle for national pride and $200,000. Seven elite pairs from Australia, Brazil, Mexico and the USA enter the Olympics of Survival. Over 40 days in Africa's Zululand, teams must survive apex predators -- and each other.

programs.title: Filthy Fortunes
programs.desc: Matt's team goes full hazmat suit to tackle a rat-infested hoard that is rumored to have cash hidden in every room, if the rats haven't eaten it already; the team also hunts for vintage Playboys, a rare samurai sword and original G.I. Joe toys.

programs.title: Filthy Fortunes
programs.desc: At a hoard Matt's been circling for years, a genius inventor's pinball and jukebox collection could bring big sales -- but only if it's intact. Removing a 1980s waterbed costs time and money. Matt needs a hazmat suit to search a fridge marked as toxic.

programs.title: Filthy Fortunes
programs.desc: Matt tackles a dangerous, ten-acre hoard in the Pennsylvania woods to hunt high-value guns and ammo; the old-school machinist's property is packed with heavy equipment and scrap metal, but $25,000 worth of precious metal could make a bet pay off.

programs.title: Expedition Bigfoot
programs.desc: Bryce Johnson, Dr. Mireya Mayor and Russell Acord scour North America in search of the cryptid known as Bigfoot; they return to northern California to explore compelling evidence and unlock this centuries-old mystery.

programs.title: Gold Rush: White Water
programs.desc: Dustin's return inspires a final push to get a life-changing pile of gold from McKinley Creek before winter freezes them out; Kayla calls one last Hail Mary play to reach House Rock bedrock payday.
